Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML/Infra)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Super helpful to hear about the model workloads and where latency/cost are the biggest pain points. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key points from today: you’re evaluating a low-latency inference path for near-real-time clinical decision support, ~1-2k qps spiky loads, concerns about KV cache persistence and audit logging for SOC2.
- Next step: 60-90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + Infra team to review architecture, integration pattern (prefix caching, batching), and quantization options.

Would you be available for a 60-90 min session next week? Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue, Mar 23: 10:00-11:30 AM
- Wed, Mar 24: 2:00-3:30 PM
- Thu, Mar 25: 9:00-10:30 AM

Planned Redwood attendees: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer), Dylan Brooks (ML/Infra), myself (AE), happy to add others if you’d like. I attached a one-page proposed agenda and a short prep doc.

Proposed agenda (attached):
1) Quick intros & goals (5-10 min)
2) Current architecture review and constraints (15-20 min)
3) Inference serving options & recommended patterns (batching, KV cache, quant) (25-30 min)
4) Integration checklist & next steps (15-20 min)
5) Q&A / open items (10 min)

Can you confirm which slot works for your team and who will join from your side? If none of these times fit, share a couple windows and we’ll align.

Thanks, look forward to getting the technical folks aligned.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
